message: 結成！　ワルセイダース!!

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, good morning, Macaron. Hard at it again today, huh」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't wake up before I get here!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-I wanted to see your sleeping face, big brother, and have a good laugh at it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's not like this house is a problem if someone comes in, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Rare to see you up this early」

name: Sally
message: 「I slack off on days when nothing's going on, but I'm an early bird when something's up~\s07」

name: Sally
message: 「Never mind that, Pres, care a little about my priva-cyy~ too」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, sorry. I figured normal people wouldn't notice the attic」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm a maiden too, you know, how rude!」

name: Sally
message: 「By the way, Mako-chii, what are we doing today again?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's this, what are you two talking about?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's a secret! I'm not telling an insensitive big brother like you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Here you go, big brother, you can have this!」
I'll let them know later that they should make sure to double-check how many they're handing out.

name: Sally
message: 「Well then, I'm gonna catch a bit more sleep~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, isn't it totally normal for demons to get along with each other?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, knowing those two, there's no way they're plotting anything bad」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sooo, I'm telling you, you're overthinking it」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what's wrong with that girl...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Doesn't it look more like she's searching for someone?」

name: Synn
message: 「Either way, she looks like she's in trouble. We can't just leave her alone」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Pretending to be kind so you can have your way with a helpless young girl--just what I'd expect from Lord Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, you spooked her because you used such a gruff voice, Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey there, welcome! I'm Nanaka Yuugiri! If you're having any trouble, just tell me anything!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Weird. That's supposed to be my friendliest greeting.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Better than looking all worn out, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my, good morning, President and Treasurer」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, there was a girl we didn't recognize wandering around」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A girl you didn't recognize? Could she be a suspicious person!?」

name: Synn
message: 「She was acting suspicious, yeah, but I don't think she's a bad kid」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There you go again. The second you see a cute girl, you're like this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, the President does have a point」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After all, someone as cute as an angel like me is a very good girl♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, I'd better hurry to the classroom or I'll be late」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, the meeting's over, so let's clean up and head home」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, I don't have club today, so let's walk home together」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's take the shopping district detour for the first time in a while!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A detour!? In that case, by all means, allow me to accompany you as well!」

name: Synn
message: 「What about Riesling coming to pick you up?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since this is an event to deepen the bonds of the Student Council, there is no problem」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's a convenient excuse, the Student Council」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't bring up the Student Council as an excuse to play around!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you'd like, won't you come too, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, guess I have no choice~. Since I'm worried, your senpai will tag along with you too\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah! In that case, I'm going too! Strictly to keep an eye on you, mind you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I've been waiting for you, Big Brother!」

name: Ria
message: 「Meeting up to go home together? How nice, how nice~」

name: Misa
message: 「E-Even I could at least meet up with Shio......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As for Jeeves, he will wait for me without me even saying anything」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though you've never done that with me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, fair enough」

name: Macaron
message: 「I wasn't waiting for Big Brother or anything!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aaah, wait, wait! That's not it either!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's what you call being a sweet little potato. Slurp.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm telling you, I was waiting for all of you, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「A proper Demon Lord's record shouldn't have any blemishes on it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, leaving things on a loss goes against my code!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey Synn, I thought you two made up?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Think of this as a necessary ritual for me to become the Demon Lord!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because if I can't even beat the likes of the Crusaders, I have no right to call myself a Demon Lord!」

name: Macaron
message: 「There's no point unless you fight me seriously!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right! That is an insult to anyone who challenges you with everything they have!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Sis Misa... you really get it」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. Facing everything fair and square, in earnest, is simply basic human etiquette」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Somehow, they're bonding over the weirdest things...」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, if we fight as things are now, it'll just end up like last time... right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even I'm not gonna stay the same forever!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I didn't cut any corners when gathering allies!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Now come forth! Fierce warrior of the Demon World, summoned by beef bowls!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hiii there! It's the Demon World's idol, Sally-chaaan♪」

name: Sally
message: 「I didn't betray anyone. I was just bribed with beef bowls~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In that case! How about a large serving of soba for breakfast every single day!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, Jiiya gave us freshly caught Mr. Sea Urchin♪」

name: Macaron
message: 「Sally-chan, do you care what happens to the beef bowl?!」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's the greatest food in the world to you? It's beef bowl!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll be on both sides! That solves everything!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Melphas told me to recruit more allies, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, with Sally-san's fighting strength, it won't make much difference anyway」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whose side are you even on, Misa」

name: Macaron
message: 「And on top of that, if I win, I'll put the Crusaders under my control!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, your younger sisters are an organization opposing the Crusaders...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just like the Warusaders, wouldn't you say!」

name: Sally
message: 「I like that! We're the Demon World Warusaders!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Waaah! No, no! We don't have such a lame name!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we can't avoid it, then we've just got to do it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hell yeah! Even a sibling brawl is the pride of a true Edoite!」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's do this fair and square--bring it on!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone, be very careful not to get hurt\s07」
